title: Joe Burrow, Tee Higgins lead huge Bengals second-half flurry, dropping Lamar Jackson-less Ravens

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Joe Burrow, Tee Higgins lead huge Bengals second-half flurry, dropping Lamar Jackson-less Ravens
sources.description: The Ravens led 13-0 at halftime without Lamar Jackson, but the Bengals exploded for 35 points after halftime.
